decisions.boundary_condition: Do not infer a fixed numeric floor, hotel class, review platform, upscale style, resort style, or budget fallback from this habit.
decisions.condition: When selecting or evaluating a hotel.
decisions.default_action: Favor hotels with strong ratings or quality signals while applying any threshold and rating metric stated for the current trip.
decisions.exception_condition: Follow the current request when it specifies a rating threshold, quality metric, or a different price-versus-quality tradeoff.
decisions.name: prefer_well_rated_hotels
decisions.rationale: The examples consistently support a soft preference for well-rated hotels, while their differing thresholds and quality descriptions do not justify a fixed numeric floor or hotel style. This general quality preference is useful alongside, and is not an alias of, the Google-specific threshold.

decisions.boundary_condition: Apply the threshold specifically to Google ratings; do not reinterpret it as a hotel-class requirement or transfer it to unrelated rating scales.
decisions.condition: When evaluating hotels using Google ratings.
decisions.default_action: Prioritize or filter for hotels rated at least 4 stars on Google.
decisions.exception_condition: If no suitable option meets the threshold alongside more important trip constraints, ask before relaxing it.
decisions.name: hotel_google_rating_floor
decisions.preference_value: Prefers hotels with a Google rating of at least 4 stars.
decisions.rationale: Repeated evidence supports a distinct, metric-specific preference for a Google rating floor of 4 stars. It is more specific than the general quality preference but does not conflict with or duplicate it.
